# Synapse 2.0.4

A fix release for Windows: the browser opens again.

## Fixed

- **The browser works on Windows.** On Windows, "Keep me signed in", "Record a task" and any agent that uses the browser failed with an error, because the browser's helper process was started without the system settings Windows needs to run a program. It now starts with them, and every other helper Synapse starts uses the same list, with a check that keeps it that way.
- **A browser that can't start says why.** If the browser still can't start, the dialog shows what it reported instead of a bare error, and agents get the same sentence.

## Install

**macOS and Linux**

```bash
curl -LsSf https://synapseorch.com/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell)**

```powershell
irm https://synapseorch.com/install.ps1 | iex
```

<details>
<summary>npm, pip or Docker</summary>

```bash
npm install -g synapse-orch-ai && synapse
pip install synapse-orch-ai && synapse         # Python 3.11–3.14 and Node.js 20.9+
```

For Docker, see [Docker](https://docs.synapseorch.com/getting-started/docker): the image is `synapseorchai/synapse-ai:2.0.4`, also `:latest`.
</details>

## Upgrading

- **From 2.0.x:** run `synapse upgrade`. Your data stays where it is, and the database is backed up first.
- **From 1.x:** run `synapse upgrade` on your 1.x install. It moves you to 2.0 the same way 2.0.0 did; read the [2.0.0 notes](https://github.com/synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai/releases/tag/v2.0.0) for what changes.

**Full changelog:** [v2.0.3...v2.0.4](https://github.com/synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai/compare/v2.0.3...v2.0.4) · [Documentation](https://docs.synapseorch.com)
